facilities.name: Atlantis Ironworks
facilities.summary: Iron and steel for Martian machinery. Hematite pellets are reduced with hydrogen in a shaft furnace at 900 degC, without coal or coke, and the sponge iron is melted to steel in an electric arc furnace.

facilities.name: Horizon Starport Propellant Depot
facilities.summary: The cryogenic tank farms of the largest starport on Mars. Liquid oxygen and liquid methane arrive by pipeline and are drawn down when a ship loads: about 2,600 t of LOX and 730 t of methane per ship.

facilities.name: Procyon Energy Station
facilities.summary: The grid of Procyon City: four heat-pipe fission modules of about 5 MWe each run around the clock, and a 12 MWp photovoltaic field adds power by day. Dust in the air cuts the solar output, most of all in a dust storm.

kpis.label: Total generation
kpis.note: design is the sol average: 19.6 MW fission plus about 4 MW solar

kpis.label: Solar output
kpis.note: design is the sol average of a 12 MWp field in clear weather

facilities.name: Procyon Propellant Works
facilities.summary: Methane and oxygen for the surface-to-orbit shuttles. Compressors take CO2 from the atmosphere, electrolysers split water into hydrogen and oxygen, and a Sabatier reactor turns CO2 and hydrogen into methane and water, which goes back to the electrolysers.

facilities.name: Sirius Air Works
facilities.summary: Breathing oxygen for the domes of Sirius City. Solid-oxide stacks, a scaled-up MOXIE, split atmospheric CO2 at 800 degC into oxygen and carbon monoxide. The dome atmosphere loop keeps the oxygen fraction at 21 %.

facilities.name: Daoya Farm No. 3
facilities.summary: A 2 ha LED-lit growth hall of wheat and soybean. Lights run 16 hours of each sol; air temperature and CO2 enrichment follow them, and the crop's growth follows the light and the CO2.

kpis.label: Biomass growth
kpis.note: design is the sol average: 26 kg/h for the 16 lit hours

facilities.name: Trantor Ice Mine
facilities.summary: Water from buried glacial ice. Hot water is pumped down Rodriguez wells, melts a pool in the ice, and the melt is pumped back up to treatment, where perchlorate is removed.
